# OpenDesk

> OpenDesk by VitalOps — open-source computer-use MCP server that lets AI agents see and control macOS, Windows and Linux desktops, locally or across paired machines. Python package `opendesk` (PyPI), JS/TS package `@vitalops/opendesk-sdk` (npm), MCP Registry name `io.github.vitalops/opendesk`. Not the openDesk office suite (ZenDiS).

Install: `claude mcp add opendesk -- uvx --from opendesk opendesk-mcp` (Claude Code), `uvx opendesk mcp` (any stdio MCP client), `npx -y @vitalops/opendesk-sdk` (Node), `pip install opendesk` (Python SDK). Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add vitalops/opendesk` then `claude plugin install opendesk@opendesk`. On macOS run `opendesk check --open` and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording to the app that runs OpenDesk. Preferred agent workflow: scripts/APIs when no GUI is needed, then `ui` (accessibility), then `screenshot(marks=true)`, then `mouse`; verify with screenshots.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/index.html): what OpenDesk is and the quick install
- [Getting started](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/getting-started/index.html): Python and JS install matrix
- [Python quickstart](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/getting-started/python.html): SDK examples, permission modes, sandbox
- [JavaScript quickstart](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/getting-started/javascript.html): Node SDK, no Python required
- [Permissions](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/getting-started/permissions.html): macOS Accessibility / Screen Recording, Linux packages, troubleshooting

## MCP

- [MCP overview](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/index.html): tools the agent sees, including peer admin tools
- [Install](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/install.html): uvx, npx, pip, npm
- [Claude Code](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/claude-code.html): one-command install and the plugin
- [Claude Desktop](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/claude-desktop.html): .mcpb bundle and JSON config
- [Cursor & VS Code](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/cursor.html): mcp.json configs
- [Continue](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/continue.html): Continue config and other clients
- [Advanced](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/advanced.html): streamable HTTP with bearer auth, annotations, isError, server instructions, embedding
- [Troubleshooting](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/mcp/troubleshooting.html): permissions, PATH, uvx caching, HTTP auth errors

## Tools

- [Tools reference](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/index.html): every tool, read-only vs acting
- [ui](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/ui.html): accessibility-based clicks and typing by element name
- [screenshot](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/screenshot.html): capture with Set-of-Marks
- [mouse](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/mouse.html): pixel-level control with Retina scaling
- [keyboard](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/keyboard.html): type, press, hotkeys
- [app](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/app.html): open, close, focus, list apps
- [clipboard](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/clipboard.html): read and write clipboard text
- [ocr](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/ocr.html): extract text from the screen
- [audit](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/audit.html): session audit log and replay
- [learn](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/learn.html): record and replay workflows
- [memory](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/tools/memory.html): local searchable screen history (`memory`, `memory_manage`)

## Remote

- [Remote control (Python)](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/remote/index.html): pair and drive other machines
- [Remote setup](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/remote/setup.html): pairing walkthrough
- [Remote via MCP](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/remote/mcp.html): opendesk_peers, opendesk_use, the `peer` argument
- [Remote security](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/remote/security.html): X25519 pairing, ChaCha20-Poly1305 frames
- [Remote control (JS)](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/remote-js/index.html): the same from Node.js

- [Architecture](https://vitalops.ai/opendesk/docs/architecture/index.html): layers, protocol, data flow
